subject: Heliogenix pilot eligibility and terms — export / KYC questions
messages:
From: Maya R. Singh <maya.singh@heliogenix.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-01-12T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot request & compliance questions

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team loved the latency and observability features. We are interested in running a 6-week pilot with Redwood Dedicated (private tenancy) to validate generative search over our bioinformatics datasets. Before we proceed we need to confirm two things on your side: 

1) Export controls / sanctions: Heliogenix has an R&D office in Country X (a jurisdiction flagged by our compliance team). Can Redwood confirm whether you can restrict deployment to US-only regions and block access from those jurisdictions? We also need an export control classification for typical transformer models used in your catalog.

2) KYC / legal: our procurement requires basic corporate KYC (company registration, beneficial owners) and a signed DPA. We may need a limited pilot discount given the scope and data sensitivity. Can you share your standard pilot terms and whether you can provide a 15–20% pilot concession?

I'm attaching a draft SOW and a short checklist of expected deliverables. If simpler, we can discuss on a quick call — available Tue/Wed next week.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Head of Data Platform
Heliogenix, Inc.
attach: Helio_SOW_draft.docx (docx)

From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Maya R. Singh <maya.singh@heliogenix.com>
Date: 2028-01-12T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request & compliance questions

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear note and the SOW. Quick answers up front: yes, we can constrain deployments by region and we do offer Dedicated pools that can be restricted to us-west/us-east only; however, export-control classification and any restrictions tied to sanctioned jurisdictions require a short review with Security and Legal.

A few clarifying items to help us scope the review:
- Can you confirm whether any engineer or user accounts require access from Country X (even via VPN)?
- Are there any specific model families you plan to use (e.g., Llama-family, Falcon, or our Redwood-curated small/medium models)?
- Please attach your corporate registration and the KYC contact (we'll keep it limited to Legal).

I'll route this to Security and Pricing for a quick eligibility check. In the meantime, I'm free Wed 10:00–11:00 PT for a 30-min call — does that work?

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
attach: pilot_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks for the summary, Tessa. Security (Soojin) should lead the export-control gating. Operational notes and my guidance: 

- Deployment geography: we can enforce region restriction at the orchestration layer; we'll require a commitment in the pilot SOW that no users from Country X will be onboarded. If Security flags risk or required controls (e.g., IP allowlists, additional logging, HSM usage for keys), we should include that as a condition.
- Classification: for most open transformer models, classification is 'dual-use' and depends on downstream use; Security + Legal will need to provide a short classification memo.
- Pricing / concession: I can approve a pilot concession up to 15% if Security signs off on the region restriction and Legal approves the DPA and limited liability language. Anything beyond 15% requires Deal Desk escalation to VP Sales.

Soojin — can you confirm whether Security is comfortable with a US-only Dedicated pool and whether additional safeguards are required? If yes, outline a short checklist and estimated delta in operational effort.

Ben — please confirm whether a conditional 15% pilot discount is ok on an SOW-level approval today, or whether you want a formal Deal Desk ticket.

I've attached our export checklist to speed the review.

- Aditya

From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-01-16T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request & compliance questions — Heliogenix (approved with conditions)

Hi Maya — quick update after internal review. We can run the 6-week Dedicated pilot under the following conditions: 

1) Regional restriction: deployment limited to our US-west Dedicated pool (no access from Country X or any sanctioned jurisdictions). We will configure IP allowlists and region enforcement in the orchestration.
2) KYC & DPA: Heliogenix must provide corporate registration and a contact for KYC; Redwood will require a signed DPA and the limited pilot SOW.
3) Data handling: logs and debug data retained for a maximum of 30 days for troubleshooting; no long-term retention unless explicitly agreed.
4) Discount: Redwood approves a time-limited 15% pilot concession contingent on Security sign-off (completed) and Legal executing our standard DPA. Anything beyond 15% requires VP Sales signoff.

I've attached the pilot agreement with redlines for the limited-data retention and region constraint. If you agree, please countersign via DocuSign and we'll kick off onboarding (target start: two business days after countersignature).

Thanks — happy to hop on a call if any of the conditions are blockers.

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

attach: pilot_agreement_redwood.pdf (pdf)
